  "category": "Dry",
  "description": "Campbell’s Cream of Mushroom Soup is made with no preservatives, tender mushrooms, and farm-fresh cream, for a creamy, rich flavor. America's favorite soup, Campbell's Condensed Soup has over 125 years of excellence, and is the start to a great recipe. A versatile secret weapon in the kitchen, Campbell's Cream of Mushroom Soup is perfect for holiday recipes, green bean casseroles, and sauces. This canned soup is more than what goes in a bowl; it’s a secret weapon for easy meals. Stir it into green bean casseroles for a creamy finish, create luscious sauces, or use it as a soup starter to elevate your weeknight dinners. From savory one-skillet meals to indulgent recipes that impress, it’s ready to inspire creativity with minimal effort. Heat it up for sipping soup comfort or transform it into something extraordinary—Cambell's creamy soups are adaptable and verstile. Stock up on Campbell's canned soup for quick recipes for cozy dinners, or rainy-day pick-me-ups. Whether it’s a chilly afternoon or a moment to share, this soup makes every bite feel a little more fun and comforting. Campbell's Soup is always ready to deliver satisfying warmth and rich flavor. From tomato soup to cream of chicken and everything in between, Campbell's Soup is always ready to deliver satisfying warmth and rich flavor. trusted staple for those moments when food is more than nourishment, it’s an expression of love through every meal.",

  "category": "Dry",
  "description": "Campbell’s Cream of Mushroom Soup is made with no preservatives, tender mushrooms, and farm-fresh cream, for a creamy, rich flavor. America's favorite soup, Campbell's Condensed Soup has over 125 years of excellence, and is the start to a great recipe. A versatile secret weapon in the kitchen, Campbell's Cream of Mushroom Soup is perfect for holiday recipes, green bean casseroles, and sauces. This canned soup is more than what goes in a bowl; it’s a secret weapon for easy meals. Stir it into green bean casseroles for a creamy finish, create luscious sauces, or use it as a soup starter to elevate your weeknight dinners. From savory one-skillet meals to indulgent recipes that impress, it’s ready to inspire creativity with minimal effort. Heat it up for sipping soup comfort or transform it into something extraordinary—Cambell's creamy soups are adaptable and verstile. Stock up on Campbell's canned soup for quick recipes for cozy dinners, or rainy-day pick-me-ups. Whether it’s a chilly afternoon or a moment to share, this soup makes every bite feel a little more fun and comforting. Campbell's Soup is always ready to deliver satisfying warmth and rich flavor.   "category": "Dry",
  "description": "Campbell’s Cream of Mushroom Soup is made with no preservatives, tender mushrooms, and farm-fresh cream, for a creamy, rich flavor. America's favorite soup, Campbell's Condensed Soup has over 125 years of excellence, and is the start to a great recipe. A versatile secret weapon in the kitchen, Campbell's Cream of Mushroom Soup is perfect for holiday recipes, green bean casseroles, and sauces. This canned soup is more than what goes in a bowl; it’s a secret weapon for easy meals. Stir it into green bean casseroles for a creamy finish, create luscious sauces, or use it as a soup starter to elevate your weeknight dinners. From savory one-skillet meals to indulgent recipes that impress, it’s ready to inspire creativity with minimal effort. Heat it up for sipping soup comfort or transform it into something extraordinary—Cambell's creamy soups are adaptable and verstile. Stock up on Campbell's canned soup for quick recipes for cozy dinners, or rainy-day pick-me-ups. Whether it’s a chilly afternoon or a moment to share, this soup makes every bite feel a little more fun and comforting. Campbell's Soup is always ready to deliver satisfying warmth and rich flavor.   "bullets": [
    "Campbell's® Condensed Cream of Potato is a vegetarian soup made with farm fresh cream for rich flavor",
    "This delicious canned soup is crafted with potatoes, perfect to enhance your favorite recipes",
    "Use this cream of potato soup as a versatile ingredient in loaded bacon potato & leek chowder, or cheesy hashbrown breakfast bake",
    "Each can is recipe-ready, offering a variety of use across multiple dishes",
    "A pantry staple that offers a quick and easy way to enhance recipes with creamy texture and rich flavor"

  "category": "Dry",
  "description": "Creamy, comforting, and endlessly versatile, Campbell’s Cream of Potato Soup brings rich, savory flavors to every bite. Made with potatoes and farm-fresh cream, its velvety texture creates a cozy experience that feels like a hug in a bowl. Crafted with no artificial colors, no high fructose corn syrup, and no added sugars, it’s a vegetarian soup that’s as thoughtful as it is delicious—perfect for sharing moments of care with loved ones. This canned soup is more than what goes in a bowl; it’s a secret weapon for easy meals. Stir it into loaded bacon potato & leek chowder for a creamy finish, create luscious sauces, or use it as a soup starter to elevate your weeknight dinners. From savory one-skillet meals to indulgent recipes that impress, it’s ready to inspire creativity with minimal effort. Heat it up for sipping soup comfort or transform it into something extraordinary—Campbell's creamy soups are adaptable and versatile. Stock up on Campbell's canned soup for quick recipes for cozy dinners or rainy-day pick-me-ups. Whether it’s a chilly afternoon or a moment to share, this soup makes every bite feel a little more fun and comforting. Campbell's Soup is always ready to deliver satisfying warmth and rich flavor. From tomato soup to cream of chicken and everything in between, Campbell's Soup is a trusted staple for those moments when food is more than nourishment—it’s an expression of love through every meal.",
